body: Sorry for the delay - this still LGTM. Many of my comments are spec text comments, which I'm wholly unqualified to provide. Hopefully @domenic or @annevk can weigh in there. Algorithm-wise, though, this looks good to me.

I'm going to do an editorial review, and think I spotted the reason the build doesn't work for me locally. There's also a merge conflict to resolve, but I can work around that locally.

I'll keep reviewing tomorrow.
A few more suggestions. Fixing the build errors first would be great so that I can use the PR preview or build it locally without applying fixes.
This is pretty big so I'm reviewing it in chunks. I've reviewed carefully up to but not including the Invokers section now.
Alright, all reviewed in detail now! I'll do another pass to look at the edits from the first round next, or all edits together if you push changes soon.
I've reviewed the changes and noticed a few small additional things.

Overall this looks reasonable, but it needs quite a bit of editorial polish still. Note that I didn't highlight every error as quite a few are repeated throughout. Hopefully these comments give you enough to pattern match across all the changed text.
Some comments apply to the next line instead due to a second unforeseen force push.
Nice. This is getting close now. I'd really appreciate it if someone else could do one detailed read through as after this many takes I'm probably missing things. Maybe @domenic or @domfarolino?
Took a brief scan before going OOO for Thanksgiving, and _mostly_ only came up with editorial things.
There's quite a bit more wrapping nits I see, but I will do a cleanup pass once these and the a11y question are addressed and OP is complete (haven't checked).

See comments on the PR to rework button states: https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10960#pullrequestreview-2602608391

TLDR this changes how popover target behaves on buttons.
It doesn't look like you added the attributes to the button element in the index?

This looks good to me, but I would like to ask you to also make the change of `<button type>` defaulting to an Auto state instead of the Submit Button state and accounting for that. I think that would vastly improve the overall story.

I think this now has everything I asked for. Thank you! I think we need at least one more editor review given the many iterations. @zcorpan expressed interest and it seems @foolip is reviewing as well.
I've gone over it all once more and spotted just a few editorial things. Thank you for your patience @keithamus!
Thanks @keithamus, I think we're good to go here. I left two final (really!) suggestions that I hope can be applied without any knock-on effects.
